```{r Import the external database and perform compound combination}
library(tidyverse)
library(base)

#---------- Aldehyde database construction -----#
#----- Part.1.1 Newly collected aldehyde data ----#
setwd(file.path(root_path, data_folder,""))
aldy_df <- read_xlsx("External_small_molecule_library.xlsx", sheet = "1.External aldehydes")

aldy_df <- aldy_df[!duplicated(aldy_df$Name),] # remove duplicated one
names <- aldy_df$Name
aldy_df <- aldy_df %>%    
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-Canonical_SMILES)
rownames(aldy_df) <- names

#----- Part.1.2 Existing aldehyde data ----#
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder,"01.features"))
aldy_havehad <- read_xlsx("Input_data_process.xlsx", sheet = "1.Aldyhydes.Result_feature")
names <- aldy_havehad$Name
aldy_havehad <- aldy_havehad %>%    
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-Serial_number, -CID, -PC_SMILES, -Formula, -Canonical_SMILES)
rownames(aldy_havehad) <- names

# Part.1.3 Merge existing and newly collected data
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(aldy_df), colnames(aldy_havehad)) # get the common 
common_row2del <- intersect(rownames(aldy_df), rownames(aldy_havehad))
if(length(common_row2del) == 0 ){}
aldy <- rbind(aldy_df[,common_cols], aldy_havehad[,common_cols])

#-------- Polyamine database construction --------#
#---- Part.2.1 Newly collected polyamine data ----#
setwd(file.path(root_path, data_folder,""))
polya_df <- read_xlsx("External_small_molecule_library.xlsx", sheet = "2.External polyamines")
polya_df <- polya_df %>%    
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-Canonical_SMILES)
polya_df <- polya_df[!duplicated(polya_df$Name),] # remove duplicated one
names <- polya_df$Name
rownames(polya_df) <- names

#----- Part.2.2 Existing polyamine data ----#
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder,"01.features"))
polya_havehad <- read_xlsx("Input_data_process.xlsx", sheet = "2.Polyamines.Result_feature")
names <- polya_havehad$Name
polya_havehad <- polya_havehad %>%    
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-Serial_number, -PC_SMILES, -CID, -Formula, -Canonical_SMILES)
polya_havehad <- polya_havehad[!duplicated(polya_havehad),]
rownames(polya_havehad) <- names

# Part.1.3 Merge existing and newly collected data
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(polya_df), colnames(polya_havehad)) # get the common 
common_row2del <- intersect(rownames(polya_df), rownames(polya_havehad))
if(length(common_row2del) == 0 ){}
polya <- rbind(polya_df[,common_cols], polya_havehad[,common_cols])

# Create a function to check all NA-like values
fxx.check_all_na <- function(x) {any(is.na(x) | is.infinite(x) | is.nan(x))}

# Clean data using the new function
aldy_df_clean <- aldy %>%
    select_if(~!fxx.check_all_na(.))
polya_df_clean <- polya %>% 
    select_if(~!fxx.check_all_na(.))

# Create empty lists to store features and target values
samples <- list()
targets <- numeric()

# Create empty dataframe to store the combined features and metadata
combined_df <- data.frame()

# Iterate through each aldehyde (row) and polyamine (column) combination in mic_df
for(aldy_cid in rownames(aldy_df_clean)) {
  # Check if the aldehyde exists in the cleaned aldehyde features data
  if(!(aldy_cid %in% rownames(aldy_df_clean))) next
  
  for(polya_cid in rownames(polya_df_clean) ) {
    # Check if the polyamine exists in the cleaned polyamine features data
    if(!(polya_cid %in% rownames(polya_df_clean))) next

    mic_value <- mic_df[aldy_cid, polya_cid] # Extract MIC value

    if(is.na(mic_value)) next # Skip if MIC value is missing
    
    # Get corresponding features
    aldy_feat <- as.numeric(aldy_df_clean[aldy_cid,])
    polya_feat <- as.numeric(polya_df_clean[polya_cid,])
    
    # Create a new row with metadata and features
    row_data <- data.frame(
      aldy_CID = aldy_cid,
      polya_CID = polya_cid,
      MIC = mic_value
    )
    r_aldy_df_clean <- as.data.frame(aldy_df_clean[aldy_cid,]) %>%
        setNames(., paste0("aldy_", colnames(.)))
    r_polya_df_clean <- as.data.frame(polya_df_clean[polya_cid,]) %>%
        setNames(., paste0("polya_", colnames(.)))
    r_row_data <- cbind(row_data, r_aldy_df_clean, r_polya_df_clean)
    # Append to the combined dataframe
    combined_df <- rbind(combined_df, r_row_data)
  }
}

# Create an empty dataframe to store combination data
combined_df <- data.frame()

# Define selected feature columns
aldy_df_clean_cols <- c("Name", "MATS5p", "topoShape", "SIC4", "MATS7c", "GATS7e","ATSC8c","MATS8c","IC5","GATS5v","BIC5","GATS7c")
polya_df_clean_cols <- c("Name", "VE2_DzZ", "VE1_DzZ", "AATSC4p", "ATSC7m")

# 1. Generate all possible combinations
combinations <- expand.grid(
    aldy_name = rownames(aldy_df_clean),
    polya_name = rownames(polya_df_clean),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 2. Extract all features at once
# Aldehyde features
aldy_features <- aldy_df_clean[combinations$aldy_name, aldy_df_clean_cols] %>% as.matrix()
colnames(aldy_features) <- paste0("aldy_", aldy_df_clean_cols)

# Polyamine features
polya_features <- polya_df_clean[combinations$polya_name, polya_df_clean_cols] %>% as.matrix()
colnames(polya_features) <- paste0("polya_", polya_df_clean_cols)

# 3. Build the final dataframe
combined_df <- data.frame(
    # aldy_Name = combinations$aldy_name,
    # polya_Name = combinations$polya_name,
    as.data.frame(aldy_features),
    as.data.frame(polya_features),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rownames(combined_df) <- c(1:nrow(combined_df))
external_combined_df <- combined_df
```
```{r For the compound combinations from external databases, model predictions were performed}
##=========================================##
# Program: Generate predictions for each model
##=========================================##

# 1. Randomly sample 200 rows from combined_df
set.seed(11)
external_sample <- combined_df[sample(nrow(combined_df), 200), ]

# 2. Get model feature names
model_features <- names(dev)[names(dev) != "labels"]

# 3. Convert feature columns to numeric
external_sample_prepared <- external_sample[, model_features] %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

# 4. Store all models in a list
models <- list(
    multinom = list(name = "Multinomial", model = multinom_model),
    svm = list(name = "SVM", model = svm_model),
    gbm = list(name = "GBM", model = gbm_model),
    rf = list(name = "Random Forest", model = rf_model),
    xgb = list(name = "XGBoost", model = xgb_model),
    knn = list(name = "KNN", model = knn_model),
    cart = list(name = "CART", model = cart_model),
    mlp = list(name = "MLP", model = mlp_model)
)

# 5. Initialize a list to store prediction results
all_predictions <- list()

# 6. Generate predictions for each model
for (model_name in names(models)) {
    tryCatch({
        if (!is.null(models[[model_name]]$model)) {
            pred_probs <- predict(
                models[[model_name]]$model,
                newdata = external_sample_prepared,
                type = "prob"
            )
            
            pred_class <- predict(
                models[[model_name]]$model,
                newdata = external_sample_prepared
            )
            
            results <- data.frame(
                Model = models[[model_name]]$name,
                aldy_Name = external_sample$aldy_Name,
                polya_Name = external_sample$polya_Name,
                Predicted_Class = pred_class
            )
            
            prob_df <- as.data.frame(pred_probs)
            names(prob_df) <- paste0("Prob_", names(prob_df))
            results <- cbind(results, prob_df)
            
            all_predictions[[model_name]] <- results
        }
    }, error = function(e) {
        NULL
    })
}

# 7. Create an Excel workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# 8. Create one sheet per model and write prediction results
for (model_name in names(all_predictions)) {
    if (!is.null(all_predictions[[model_name]])) {
        sheet_name <- models[[model_name]]$name
        addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
        
        model_results <- all_predictions[[model_name]]
        writeData(wb, sheet_name, model_results)
        
        writeData(
            wb,
            sheet_name,
            data.frame(
                Predicted_Class = names(table(model_results$Predicted_Class)),
                Count = as.numeric(table(model_results$Predicted_Class))
            ),
            startRow = nrow(model_results) + 3
        )
    }
}

# 9. Add a summary sheet
addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
summary_data <- data.frame(
    Model = character(),
    Sample_Count = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (model_name in names(all_predictions)) {
    if (!is.null(all_predictions[[model_name]])) {
        summary_data <- rbind(
            summary_data,
            data.frame(
                Model = models[[model_name]]$name,
                Sample_Count = nrow(all_predictions[[model_name]])
            )
        )
    }
}

writeData(wb, "Summary", summary_data)

# 10. Save the Excel file
out_dir <- "03.train_model/12.external_validation"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
saveWorkbook(wb, "all_models_predictions.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r Read the results of all model-evaluated compound combinations}
##=========================================##
# Program: Evaluate all models
##=========================================##

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "03.train_model/12.external_validation"))
excel_file <- "all_models_predictions.xlsx"

library(openxlsx)

# Predefined sheet names
sheet_names <- c(
  "Multinomial", "SVM", "GBM", "Random Forest",
  "XGBoost", "KNN", "CART", "MLP"
)

model_results_list <- list()

# Read prediction results for each model
for (sheet in sheet_names) {
  tryCatch({
    model_data <- read.xlsx(excel_file, sheet = sheet)
    model_results_list[[sheet]] <- model_data
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Failed to read sheet: %s", sheet))
  })
}
```
```{r For the model prediction results: pie chart + proportion table in Excel}
#==============================================================##
## Program: Model prediction proportions
##==============================================================##

all_proportions <- list()

library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)

for (sheet in c("Multinomial", "SVM", "GBM", "Random Forest", "XGBoost", "KNN", "CART", "MLP")) {
  pred_proportions <- table(model_results_list[[sheet]]$Predicted_Class) %>%
    prop.table() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames(c("Predicted_Class", "Proportion"))
  
  pred_proportions$Percentage <- sprintf("%.2f%%", pred_proportions$Proportion * 100)
  pred_proportions$Model <- sheet
  
  all_proportions[[sheet]] <- pred_proportions
  
  df_pie <- pred_proportions %>%
    rename(
      ratio = Proportion,
      trait = Predicted_Class
    )
  
  pie_plot <- ggplot() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal"
    ) +
    xlab("") +
    ylab("") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3C5488FF", "#F39B7FFF", "#8491B4FF", "#91D1C2FF")) +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = df_pie,
      stat = "pie",
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = 1, r = 2, amount = ratio, fill = trait),
      color = "white",
      size = 1
    )
  
}

all_proportions_df <- do.call(rbind, all_proportions)

wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Prediction_Proportions")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Prediction_Proportions", all_proportions_df)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "03.train_model/12.2.external_validation.proportion/model_prediction_proportions.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r For the model prediction results: overlap with Class 4}
class4_combinations <- list()

for(sheet in names(model_results_list)) {
  current_model_data <- model_results_list[[sheet]]
  name_col <- c("aldy_Name","polya_Name")  
  class4_combinations[[sheet]] <- current_model_data[current_model_data$Predicted_Class == "Class4", name_col]
}

common_class4_samples <- Reduce(intersect, class4_combinations)
common_class4_samples <- common_class4_samples[!is.na(common_class4_samples$aldy_Name) & !is.na(common_class4_samples$polya_Name), ]
```

```{r Assessed the quality of the self-test data in the model predictions}
#=========================================##
## Program: Check existing MIC data for polyamines and aldehydes
##=========================================##

library(readxl)

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "01.features"))
mic_df <- read_excel("3.mic_data.xlsx", sheet = "4.MIC")

polya_havehad_name <- c(
  "Bis(3-aminopropyl)amine",
  "Diethylenetriamine",
  "Polyethylenimine linear",
  "Spermine",
  "Spermidine"
)

aldy_havehad_name <- c(
  "Vanillin",
  "(E)-2-hexenal",
  "Cinnamaldehyde",
  "(E)-2-heptenal",
  "(E)-oct-2-enal",
  "Citral",
  "(E)-non-2-enal",
  "(2E,4E)-deca-2,4-dienal",
  "(E)-dec-2-enal"
)

combinations_havehad <- expand.grid(
  aldy_Name = aldy_havehad_name,
  polya_Name = polya_havehad_name,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

intersect(combinations_havehad, common_class4_samples)

name_col <- c("aldy_Name", "polya_Name", "Prob_Class4", "Predicted_Class")

class4_combinations_prob <- lapply(model_results_list, function(model_data) {
  model_data %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(name_col)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(Prob_Class4))
})

fxx.find_combination_stats <- function(model_data, comb) {
  match_row <- model_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(aldy_Name == comb$aldy_Name & polya_Name == comb$polya_Name)

  if (nrow(match_row) > 0) {
    rank <- which(
      model_data$aldy_Name == comb$aldy_Name &
      model_data$polya_Name == comb$polya_Name
    )

    return(data.frame(
      aldy_Name = comb$aldy_Name,
      polya_Name = comb$polya_Name,
      Class4_Prob = match_row$Prob_Class4,
      Predicted_Class = match_row$Predicted_Class,
      Rank = rank
    ))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

results_by_model <- list()

for (model_name in names(class4_combinations_prob)) {
  model_results <- data.frame()

  for (i in 1:nrow(combinations_havehad)) {
    comb <- combinations_havehad[i, ]
    stats <- fxx.find_combination_stats(class4_combinations_prob[[model_name]], comb)

    if (!is.null(stats)) {
      stats$Model <- model_name
      model_results <- rbind(model_results, stats)
    }
  }

  results_by_model[[model_name]] <- model_results
}

all_combinations_stats <- do.call(rbind, results_by_model)

writexl::write_xlsx(all_combinations_stats, "combinations_havehad_stats.xlsx")
```
